summary.text: Meredith Craig is a Republican state representative who has represented Ohio House District 77 since January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her prior experience in the Ohio State Senate, the Ohio Department of Insurance and the Ohio Chamber of Commerce.

paragraphs.text: Craig earned a B.A. in history and political science from Malone University.
Her career included roles in the Ohio State Senate, the Ohio Department of Insurance and the Ohio Chamber of Commerce.
She defeated Josh Hlavaty, Bill Albright, Dennis Finley and Frank Grande in the March 19, 2024 Republican primary and then defeated Democrat Mark Gooch in the November 5, 2024 general election.
She serves on the Health, Insurance (as vice chair), and Veterans and Military Development committees.
Brooke Dillon is the Democratic candidate in the 2026 general election.
